configSchemaNote: Cerebrum needs no user configuration and no credentials, so the schema is an empty object. Pass it only if the publish flow asks for one.
description: Cerebrum searches scholarly indexes for your research question and answers from the papers it finds. Every answer names its sources in a numbered list with authors, year, and a DOI where one exists, and states how many records the search gathered and how many sources it cited. When an answer is assembled from source excerpts rather than full synthesis, the result says so in plain words. A second tool returns the current Trending in Science edition, the top science headlines of the day grouped by section with links to the original stories. Cerebrum needs no account and asks for nothing but the question itself.
namespaceNote: Proposed namespace. Smithery namespaces are globally unique and lowercase, so availability is only confirmed when the account creates it. If askcerebrum is taken, publish under the account username namespace instead and update qualifiedName to match.
